# upsnap_settings (Resource)

UpSnap's global settings, stored in the `settings_private` and `settings_public` singleton records. Requires superuser credentials.

There is only one settings object, so creating this resource adopts it, unset arguments keep their current values, and destroying it only removes it from the Terraform state. UpSnap applies the `UPSNAP_INTERVAL`, `UPSNAP_SCAN_RANGE` and `UPSNAP_WEBSITE_TITLE` environment variables on every start, overriding these values; avoid setting both. The favicon cannot be managed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "upsnap_settings" "this" {
  interval          = "*/5 * * * * *"
  scan_range        = "192.168.1.0/24"
  lazy_ping         = true
  track_ip_interval = "0 */10 * * * *"
  website_title     = "Homelab"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `interval` (String) Cron expression for how often devices are pinged, for example `*/3 * * * * *` (every three seconds).
- `lazy_ping` (Boolean) Only ping devices while someone has UpSnap open.
- `scan_range` (String) Network range in CIDR notation scanned for new devices, for example `192.168.1.0/24`. Empty disables scanning.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `track_ip_interval` (String) Cron expression for how often devices with `track_ip` are looked up by MAC. Empty disables IP tracking.
- `website_title` (String) Title shown in the browser tab and the web app manifest. Empty uses `UpSnap`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `settings`.
- `setup_completed` (Boolean) Whether a superuser exists, which UpSnap tracks to show its setup wizard.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = upsnap_settings.this
  identity = {
    id = "settings"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) Always `settings`.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = upsnap_settings.this
  id = "settings"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The settings are a singleton and always use the ID "settings".
terraform import upsnap_settings.this settings
```
